p: Google and Amazon both opened their own AI chips to PyTorch apps this week.
Most AI apps are written to run on Nvidia chips by default. These new tools let them move without a rewrite.
By some accounts, TechCrunch reports. Meta built PyTorch in 2016 and handed it to the Linux Foundation in 2022.
Now open source under Apache 2.0. Existing PyTorch apps move to Google's TPU chips with a simple configuration change.
Open source under Apache 2.0, in public beta from 20 October. In eager mode, moving a model to Trainium takes one line of code.
